params.asset: Address of the collateral asset to price for this market

getHistoricalPrice(uint256).details: Used by the circuit breaker to calculate price volatility      over the lookback window. Must return the price that was      current at (block.timestamp - secondsAgo), or 0 if unavailable.

params.secondsAgo: How many seconds back to query

returns._0: price Historical price with 18 decimals, or 0 if unavailable

getPrice().details: isTrusted covers staleness, sequencer-liveness (on L2s), AND      session-awareness (e.g., equity feeds outside trading windows).      The engine rejects any price where isTrusted == false.

returns.isTrusted: Whether the price is currently reliable
returns.updatedAt: Unix timestamp of the last price update

setQuote(address,uint256,uint256,bool).details: Factory-only access models the controlled configuration step used by      production adapters. `trusted` must be explicitly supplied so a new      market cannot accidentally consume an unreviewed quote.

params.trusted: Whether the quote passes the adapter's trust checks

configure(address,address).notice: Configure the adapter for a specific market

getHistoricalPrice(uint256).notice: Get a historical price from a given number of seconds ago

getPrice().notice: Get the current price and trust status

setQuote(address,uint256,uint256,bool).notice: Set the fixed quote used by a configured market.
